:::{#def-angle}
#### Angle between two vectors

The **angle** between two nonzero vectors, $\vecf{x}, \vecf{y} \in \reals^p$, is

$$
\angpar \eqdef \arccos\paren{\cossim(\vecf{x}, \vecf{y})}.
$$

In words, the angle is the [arccosine](algebra-trigonometry.qmd#def-arccosine)
of the [cosine similarity](#def-cosine-similarity) of the two vectors.

:::
